review_candidates.title: Commercial and Contract Manager
review_candidates.description: 𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 — Contracts & Commercial Manager | 𝗥𝗘𝗠𝗢𝗧𝗘 Johnson Controls Arabia is looking for a Contracts & Commercial Manager to own the contractual and commercial position of our turnkey industrial and refrigeration projects across the Kingdom — working fully remotely from Egypt. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ABOUT US Johnson Controls Arabia (JCA) is the Kingdom's joint venture of Johnson Controls International — a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. From our manufacturing, engineering and service bases in Jeddah, Riyadh and the Eastern Province, we design, manufacture, install, commission and maintain the systems that keep industrial and commercial facilities running — complete turnkey delivery, from concept design through construction, commissioning and long-term service. OUR FIELDS OF SPECIALTY • Industrial refrigeration — ammonia (NH₃/R717), CO₂ and cascade low-charge systems; Sabroe and Frick screw and reciprocating compressor packages for cold stores, freezing tunnels, blast freezers, IQF lines and process cooling • Specialised low-temperature facilities — large-scale cold storage and logistics, food, dairy, poultry and pharmaceutical plants, and indoor snow, ice and low-temperature leisure venues • HVAC and district cooling — YORK chillers, air handling, ventilation and dehumidification • Controls, automation and building solutions — BMS, PLC/SCADA integration, energy performance • Fire, security and life-safety systems • Aftermarket service — PM contracts, overhauls, shutdowns, spare parts and 24/7 support All work executed to IIAR, ASHRAE, NFPA, SASO and Saudi Building Code requirements, under JCI's global quality, ethics and EHS standards. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ THE ROLE Position: Contracts & Commercial Manager Reports to: Project Manager Location: 𝗥𝗲𝗺𝗼𝘁𝗲 — Egypt Type: Full-time, permanent — remote working JOB PURPOSE Own the contractual and commercial position of our turnkey industrial and refrigeration construction projects — protecting the company's entitlements, controlling disbursement, driving certification and collection, and ensuring that every riyal committed is contractually recoverable and every riyal earned is invoiced and collected on time. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Contract administration & entitlement protection • Own the head contract: interpret conditions, obligations, notices and time bars, and brief the project team on what the contract requires of them • Operate a disciplined notice regime — every notification, claim and reservation of rights issued within the contractual time limits, with complete supporting records • Maintain the contemporaneous record file that substantiates entitlement • Advise the Project Manager on contractual risk and the commercial consequences of technical and programme decisions Variations, claims & change control • Identify, price, submit and negotiate variations, extensions of time, prolongation and disruption costs • Prepare and defend claims; support dispute avoidance, negotiation, mediation or arbitration • Operate change control so no work proceeds without a priced and authorised instruction Cash, certification & collection • Prepare and agree monthly valuations and payment applications; drive certification and collection to protect project cash flow • Monitor receivables, escalate late certification or payment, report the collection position monthly • Control disbursement — verify that committed costs are budgeted, authorised and recoverable Cost control & commercial reporting • Own the cost baseline: commitments, actuals, accruals, cost-to-complete forecasts and margin tracking • Integrate cost with planning for Earned Value reporting and variance analysis • Issue the monthly commercial report: work done, certified, invoiced, collected, cost, forecast margin and exposure Procurement & subcontract management • Prepare subcontract and supply packages; run tender evaluations and negotiate terms back-to-back with the head contract • Administer subcontract accounts, valuations, variations, back-charges and final accounts • Ensure bonds, guarantees, insurances and warranties are in place, valid and released on time Governance & compliance • Ensure compliance with Saudi law, ZATCA/VAT requirements and JCI delegation of authority, ethics and compliance policies • Support internal and external audit; maintain an auditable commercial record from mobilisation to final account • Lead the commercial close-out: final account, release of retention and securities WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Law or Finance • 10+ years in contracts and commercial management with a main contractor, EPC or turnkey systems provider — at least 5 at manager level • Proven record on large industrial, EPC, cold storage, refrigeration, energy or major building projects, ideally in KSA/GCC • Demonstrated success in settling variations, extensions of time and claims, and in securing certification and collection under pressure • Strong command of FIDIC and bespoke KSA client contract forms, Saudi contract and labour law, and the ZATCA/VAT framework • Measurement, BoQ, valuation and cost-control practice; EVM principles; ERP (SAP/Oracle) and advanced Excel • Professional membership (RICS / CIOB / MCIArb) is a strong advantage • Excellent English; Arabic a strong advantage for authority and client dealings REMOTE WORKING REQUIREMENTS • Able to work as a fully remote member of a project team — disciplined self-management, strong written communication, and responsiveness across the Sunday–Thursday working week (Arabian Standard Time) • Deep familiarity with KSA contractual, regulatory and ZATCA practice is essential • Available for occasional travel to the Kingdom for negotiations, audits and key contractual milestones WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • No entitlement lost to a missed notice or expired time bar • Valuations certified and collected within contractual periods • Variations priced, agreed and instructed before the work is executed • Forecast margin protected or improved against the approved budget • A clean, auditable commercial record — and a clean final account at close-out ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Interested, or know someone who fits? Send your CV to hossam.elsayed@jci.com or message me directly. #Hiring #RemoteJobs #ContractsManager #CommercialManager #QuantitySurveying #Construction #IndustrialRefrigeration #SaudiArabia #JohnsonControls #FIDIC #Claims #CostControl
